id: title:Gilbert09:skip bucket check when botocore rejects the endpoint

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability for self-hosted or container-IP S3 backends
review.reason: Adds a try/except block around boto3.client instantiation, catching ValueError and returning early if the error message contains 'Invalid endpoint'. This allows the bucket existence check to skip rather than abort when botocore rejects an endpoint hostname, while still re-raising unrelated ValueErrors.
review.uncertainty: The score relies on the assumption that this specific error handling represents a substantive, bounded improvement rather than a narrow maintenance fix. The production implementation is present, but the broader context of warehouse ingestion and the actual benefit of this specific exception handling is not fully demonstrated by the hunk alone. No tests or documentation are provided

observations.behavior: Adds a try/except block around boto3.client instantiation, catching ValueError and returning early if the error message contains 'Invalid endpoint'. This allows the bucket existence check to skip rather than abort when botocore rejects an endpoint hostname, while still re-raising unrelated ValueErrors.
observations.posthog_connection: This change improves the reliability of the S3 backend initialization for PostHog's warehouse ingestion. It prevents the warehouse sync from failing during startup if the configured S3 endpoint hostname is rejected by botocore's client builder, while still allowing the actual storage layer (delta-rs) to proceed and report real errors later. This supports self-hosted or container-IP
